name: Model physics client fixture
description: The fixture of guided check 16e-cc16e (mods/tests/client-pass/Dev28ClothChains.cs): a banner to place (cloth from assets/physics.json, a collider), a worn cape cut down its middle for its UVs (cloth on the player's Chest joint, a collider on it) and a creature wearing a three-link pendant (a chain its body block declares). build-assets.py writes the sources and cooks them. On a game client its code counts, read only, how often the game's cloth and chain code runs (the sigdb features models.cloth.readers and models.chain2.readers) and writes the counts to kiln/data/model-physics-client/counts.json.
